LanguageData.RimWard.Page.Policies.Intro: Hospital policies belong to the colony (the save) and apply to every map, also after a gravship landing. A map may keep its own.
LanguageData.RimWard.Page.Policies.NoGame: Open or start a game to see and change this colony's hospital policies. A new colony starts open when "Open the hospital in new colonies" is on.
LanguageData.RimWard.Page.Policies.OwnMap: This map has its own policies.
LanguageData.RimWard.Page.Pricing.Intro: What a patient pays: every charge on the bill, times the factors below, capped at the maximum payout. The Bill column, the offer letter and the silver you get use this same calculation.
LanguageData.RimWard.Page.Pricing.LinesText: Admission, every treatment with medicine, every meal a doctor feeds, every operation (a work fee) and the medicine and parts it uses from your stock. A failed operation charges no fee.
LanguageData.RimWard.Page.Pricing.Noble: Noble in a private / shared room
LanguageData.RimWard.Page.Pricing.ExampleText: A patient whose bill is {0}, who rested in a private room and was treated by your chief physician, pays {1}.
LanguageData.RimWard.Page.Pricing.EarlyText: Dismissed, treatment impossible or a death that is not your fault: {0} of the bill so far. Maximum stay pays in full.
LanguageData.RimWard.Page.Pricing.EarlyOff: Billing extras are off: a patient who leaves uncured pays nothing.
LanguageData.RimWard.Page.Black.Intro: Never send patients with these diseases, for these operations, or from these factions. The lists are the same for every save.
